title: Pope Leo XIV, in Paris, cautions against losing humanity in 'paradise of machines'
subhead: In a speech at the start of his four-day visit to France, the pope warned against the dangers of AI and other technologies, stressed that 'authentic secularity' should not exclude religion, and urged France to be a 'tireless champion of peace.'

title: Zinédine Zidane takes charge of first match as France manager

title: Actress Marina Vlady, unforgettable 'Princess of Cleves,' dies at 88
subhead: Alternating between popular cinema and auteur films, the French actress with Russian origins appeared in some 100 movies. A woman of strong values who signed France's 'Manifesto of 343' for abortion rights, she died on September 24, at the age of 88.
